description: Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime Evergreen Bootstrapper. Embedded in the Shell-flavor installer with dontcopy, extracted to {tmp} and run only when WebView2 is missing; never installed into {app}. The pinned copy is committed in cache/ (redistributable; Microsoft republishes the file behind the fwlink every few weeks, so a tagged build must not depend on the download); fetch_webview2_bootstrapper.ps1 verifies its sha256 and Authenticode signer and only downloads when cache/ has no copy.
signer_subject: CN=Microsoft Corporation, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US
signer_issuer: CN=Microsoft Code Signing PCA 2024, O=Microsoft Corporation, C=US
signer_root_subject: CN=Microsoft Root Certificate Authority 2011, O=Microsoft Corporation, L=Redmond, S=Washington, C=US
repin: Microsoft republishes the bootstrapper behind the same fwlink. On a hash mismatch run fetch_webview2_bootstrapper.ps1 -Repin, review the printed signer (it is listed side by side with signer_thumbprint, signer_issuer and signer_root_subject here), then update sha256 and the signer fields here and WebView2BootstrapperSha256 in Tesseract-shell.iss together (ISCC refuses to compile when the two sha256 pins differ). -Repin keeps its staging copy for review: delete cache/repin-* by hand once reviewed.
